decision: Compare one fresh 98-sample feature grid before free refinement of a coarse 16-control feature layout. Require geometry and paper validity, plus lower unweighted clearance error if the incumbent geometry is valid. Retain its original clearance grid. Skip only exact repeated rollback blocks; retain the final partial block. Targets, cut constraints and final acceptance thresholds stay fixed.

preflight.name: original
preflight.method: Offline diagnostic of newly initialized and clearance-fitted grids, before any free refinement. No saved geometry, no deadlines, no production acceptance claim.

paperDetails.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.

schedulingOnlyAttempt.reason: Interrupted the ongoing full suite after inspecting the vertical-shift failure: the retry was skipped with 2.984 seconds left. Preserve this failed attempt separately from the cycle-skip implementation.

visualDetailReview.method: Post-hoc visual diagnostic. Manual fixed rectangular window around the sun detail; same vertical crop and rendered export. This window is not an independently annotated ground-truth motif and did not enter optimization or acceptance. Source input encodes the original binary mask as red/white; rendered black means source red.

firstFallbackFailure.reason: Full inverse suite failed two of 735 tests: vertical-shift independent 800-pixel error was 3.00203125%; negative-diagonal retry was not scheduled. Merely lowering the retry time threshold still skipped it in a repeated run.

qualifications: The nine translations are a development study of one photograph, not nine independent motif families.
Independent image errors use the fixed classified photographic masks, not unavailable ground-truth artwork or cutting geometry.
Native ten-second checks and browser click-to-ready timings are distinct; browser runs use the UI budget.
No physical assembly testing. The nominal geometry and guarded paper-core checks retain their documented limits.
Original collage benchmark successes remain separate from new crop-perturbation successes.
